We place an upper limit on the double parton scattering cmss of ~DP < 120 nb (95% C.L.) for partons with transverse momenta greater than 18 GeV/c. Implications for physics at the SSC (4 = 40 TeV) are discussed.

## 1. Introduction

In the context of the standard model, the dominant production mechanism for events containing four high transverse momentum (pr) jets at the Tevatron collider is double gluon bremsstrahlung (DB). In principle, four-jet events may also be produced by double parton (DP) scattering, where two hard scatters occur within one hadron interaction’. Such events are expected to contain valuable information on parton correlations. The predicted rise2 in the ratio unP/uDB with ,L merits a search for double parton scattering at CDF.

## 4. Conclusions

We observe good agreement between the results of leading order QCD and data for the pi spectra and inter-jet angles of four-jet events. Using variables sensitive to a double parton signal, we find a small (- 5%) double parton content
